variants.name: Fluent Light
variants.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE high-resolution landscape design-system presentation image, 16:10 landscape. A polished realistic Windows WPF desktop application concept named FAKT, in Russian. Flat front-facing screenshot, no laptop, no perspective, no web browser, no marketing landing page. The application finds files within a selected folder, detects tabular structure in CSV/TXT/XML, excludes non-tabular files from selection without deleting anything, maps source columns into an EXISTING database table, validates then imports.
Board composition: upper 84% one large highly legible complete desktop application window with Windows title controls. Bottom 16% compact design-system specimen strip: variant number and English name, 5 color chips labeled hex, Segoe UI typography sample, primary and secondary buttons, success/warning/error badges, small metrics for spacing and row height. This strip is outside the app.
App must show realistic Russian labels: "Папка", "Выбрать папку", "Найдено 24", "Табличных 18", "Пропущено 6", "Структура", "Сопоставление полей", "Проверить", "Импортировать". Path D:\Data\Import. File samples sales.csv selected, clients.xml, report.txt, notes.txt with skipped badge. Preview table with columns order_id, date, amount and 4 realistic rows. Existing destination "База: Accounting", "Таблица: dbo.Sales". Mapping order_id → Id (int), date → SaleDate (date), amount → Amount (decimal). Status "3 из 3 полей сопоставлены", "1 240 строк готовы". Clear hierarchy, believable working software, readable Russian typography, aligned data grid cells, crisp thin icons, careful spacing. No illustrations, no decorative charts, no giant empty areas.
Variant 01 / Fluent Light: Windows-native light Fluent style. Cool white #F7F9FC, blue #2563EB, graphite text. Segoe UI, 6px radii, 32px table rows, subtle borders. Left navigation, central file list above preview table, right mapping inspector.
